title: Origin story: Pinocchio
description: Pinocchio was carved by Geppetto from a talking log, a puppet who longed to be a real boy. His nose grew with every lie; he was hanged, burned, turned half-donkey on Pleasure Island, and swallowed by the shark — earning his humanity at last by saving Geppetto from its belly.
